changelog:
- Permanent Signing Key: Configured consistent release keystore across all builds. Resolves package conflict errors permanently so future in-app updates install seamlessly with 1 tap.
- Complete YouTube Shorts Neutralization: Auto-converts any Shorts link or background auto-transition into the standard normal player (/watch?v=...) and purges Shorts tabs and shelves from the UI.
- Fixed Images & Videos Discovery Studios: Switched modal display architecture to guaranteed full-screen flex with error resilience so 4K wallpapers and trending videos open instantly on the home page.
- 1-Tap Browser Favorites: Direct dynamic gold star bookmarking on toolbar and menu.
- Redesigned Cyber Ghost & Truth Pulse Icons: Enlarged sleek touch targets with futuristic glowing SVGs.
- Fresh 2026 Sports Headlines & Dynamic Editorial Photos: Unique photos per story and updated 2026 sports feeds.
